dataset: kcat from enzyme sequence and substrate

split.rule: MinHash 5-mer LSH clusters, whole clusters assigned to folds
split.WARNING: a random split leaks badly here; homologous enzymes share kcat

files.kcat_records.tsv: one row per measurement; fold is the ONLY split to use
files.esm2_8M_mean.npy: float16 [n_seq, 320] mean-pooled ESM2-t6-8M, row order = sequences.json
files.sequences.json: sequence strings, index-aligned to seq_id and the embedding
files.substrate_ecfp.npy: uint8 [n_smiles, 256], Morgan r=2 2048-bit packed; np.unpackbits to use
files.seq_features.npy: float32 [n_seq, 25]: log10 length, 20 aa frequencies, 4 class fractions

forbidden: random splits -- use the fold column
training on physical law; tanh(b*T/4) and Smoluchowski are exact and belong in evaluation, not in the loss
scoring against DLKcat any model whose features were derived from DLKcat (loop 129 lost 160 of 169 validation genes to exactly this)
reporting a score without the constant, nearest-neighbour and composition baselines
